newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher as market stabilises.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher as market stabilises.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher for a third straight session as the market stabilised following lingering bearishness, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 46 points or 2.37 percent up at 1,979.67 on a turnover of 97.5 million taka. Of 95 traded issues, 64 gained and 27 lost.

"The prices rose due to short supply of scrips and mounting buying interest," said one broker. IDLC gained 208 taka to 4,608, Apex Foods shed 1,059 to 9,529 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 16 to 216. The market will remain closed on Friday due to weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
